name: CSV Import Users
description: Bulk-creates Drupal user accounts from an uploaded CSV file (admin tool).
project_description: CSV Import Users adds a single administrative form at /admin/config/people/user-import that reads an uploaded CSV file and creates one active Drupal user account per row. Each row is keyed by CSV headers; rows require a 'username' and 'email' column, may name a 'role' to assign, and may map any of the site's configured user fields (selected via checkboxes on the form) — including 'user_picture', which accepts either an existing file URI or a URL that is fetched and saved. Existing usernames are skipped. The module ships no configuration, permissions, services or schema of its own; the form is reached with core's 'administer users' permission and depends on the core User and File modules.
